esp32.detail: 7 pins wired; U2.EN → D25 (GPIO25). U2.STEP → D26 (GPIO26). U2.DIR → D27 (GPIO27). Added a separate 12 V supply for VM (it needs 5.5–35 V and up to 2 A, more than the board can give); its − joins the board's GND. Added the tmc2208.py driver written from the datasheet.
Drives EN low, steps 1600 forward (DIR high) and 1600 back (DIR low), then EN high: passes
